products.title: Eggless Raw Edible Cookie Dough, Edible Frozen Cookie Dough - Big Dipper Dough Co (4 Pints: Chocolate Chip | Rocket Chip)

description.text:
Delicious Flavors - Whether you want classic chocolate chip cookies, a creamy oreos cookie dough, or a pop of cherry, we got you covered! Enjoy all of our delicious unbaked cookie dough flavors: Rocket Chip, Galactic Fusion, and Super Cluster.
All-natural Ingredients - We only use the best to create our cookies dough. With real Idaho butter, American wheat flour, Madagascar vanilla, Wisconsin cherries, West African chocolate chips, and sea salt, this cookie mix is truly mouthwatering.
Great for Snack and Dessert Time - Eat it by the spoonful. Mix or top over your favorite ice cream scoop. Smash it between 2 chocolate crinkle cookies.
Satisfy Your Cravings the Safe Way - Unlike your regular cookie or biscuit dough, our premium chocolate chip cookie mix is egg-free. It’s entirely safe to eat raw so enjoy every cookie scoop without worrying about feeling sick.
Ready to Eat - Grab a spoon because this is the perfect edible cookie dough. No need to make dough from scratch. Enjoy your edible cookie dough right of the scoop straight from the tub!

products.title: Ben & Jerry's Dough Chunks Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Non-GMO 8 oz

description.text: Ben & Jerry's the dough, the whole dough, and nothing but the dough! this one’s for you, chocolate chip cookie dough lovers. no more digging for just one more doughy bite — now you can munch on dough chunk after dough chunk to your heart’s content. As much as we love ice cream — and whoa do we love ice cream — for us, it’s always been about the chunks. euphoria starts and ends with those glorious chunks and swirls. and ever since 1984, fans have been particularly in love with our cookie dough chunks. when an anonymous fan suggested we put gobs of cookie dough in our vanilla ice cream, we couldn’t believe what a great idea it was. we’ve been doing it ever since, and now the cookie dough story has a new chapter; just the dough. no more wrist cramps from digging cookie dough chunks out of your pint, no more hoping for just one more doughy chunk. the future is now, cookie dough lovers. gobble these up on their own, or sprinkle them over your bowl of ice cream to add even more doughy euphoria. Chocolate chip cookie dough chunks are made with non gmo sourced ingredients, fairtrade certified cocoa, sugar, and vanilla, and cage free eggs. feel good about every doughy bite.

products.title: Nestle Toll House Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough

description.text: Nestle Toll House Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough makes classic chocolate chip cookies in minutes for a treat the whole family will enjoy. This cookie dough is full of semi sweet morsels, for a cookie that delivers the rich, creamy semi-sweet chocolate taste you love from Nestle Toll House. This refrigerated cookie dough contains no preservatives, artificial flavors, or colors, and the chocolate chips are made with 100% real chocolate. Simply spoon heaping teaspoons of Nestle Toll House cookie dough onto an ungreased baking sheet and bake until golden brown. Keep this cookie dough refrigerated until the use by date on the package or freeze before the use by date on the package for up to 2 months until ready to enjoy.
